attempts.summary: Deployed a rootless podman container (httpd:alpine) as the unprivileged appsvc user on node1, serving on port 8080, managed via a podman quadlet (.container) systemd --user unit with lingering enabled so it starts at boot without any active login session. Verified via a full node reboot that the container, service, and port-8080 availability all recover automatically while appsvc remains session-less.
